title: THE HALLOWEEN ISSUE · title page
venue: the Timberline · an unpublished Halloween issue · Box 1
logline: The title page, drawn before page one: the masthead over the series' one image, with nobody in it. It letters the title, the subtitle and the tagline. The cafeteria at night. The tray line moving with no one at it.

panels.composition: The masthead across the top third. Below it the cafeteria at night in a single flashlight beam: the tray line's rollers, the hairnet on its hook, the tables up on their ends like gravestones, and the beam's edge catching one ladle on the far wall. Nobody in it.

image.notes: The issue's cover. The horror is the spotting.
